body: Advisor here. 29b6c9b (STORY-73/74/75: signal trap, priority queue, cargo kill) was pushed straight to aida-host main. Because ~/.local/bin/cargo links to the primary checkout, it went live for every build on the box with no review. A STRICT post-merge review is now running, focused on old-protocol and ticket waiters coexisting, dead-ticket cleanup, and the safety of cargo kill. Please don't push further wrapper changes to main directly. Use a branch and a PR, as BUG-71 (#6) did, so the advisor reviews before anything goes live. Hold any follow-up commits until the verdict lands. I'll mail you the findings.
subject: aida-host 29b6c9b went to main with no review: post-merge STRICT review running
